description: For every \(n\in\mathbb N\), assign \(x=-n\). The formula \(\forall y\,\neg(y<x)\) is true in \(A_n=\{z\in\mathbb Z:-n\le z\}\) and false in \(A_{n+1}\), whereas \(\exists y\,(y<x)\) is false in \(A_n\) and true in \(A_{n+1}\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.ElementaryChains.integer_tail_boundaries (n : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.Entry.ElementaryChains.isLeast.Realize default ![Lemmatheca.Entry.ElementaryChains.tailLeast n] ∧
    ¬Lemmatheca.Entry.ElementaryChains.isLeast.Realize default
          ![(Lemmatheca.Entry.ElementaryChains.integerTails.inclusion n (n + 1) ⋯)
              (Lemmatheca.Entry.ElementaryChains.tailLeast n)] ∧
      ¬Lemmatheca.Entry.ElementaryChains.hasPredecessor.Realize default
            ![Lemmatheca.Entry.ElementaryChains.tailLeast n] ∧
        Lemmatheca.Entry.ElementaryChains.hasPredecessor.Realize default
          ![(Lemmatheca.Entry.ElementaryChains.integerTails.inclusion n (n + 1) ⋯)
              (Lemmatheca.Entry.ElementaryChains.tailLeast n)]
